values.Example: A witness saw the accident from her window.
values.ExampleTranslation: Một nhân chứng nhìn thấy vụ tai nạn từ cửa sổ của mình.
values.MeaningEn: a person who saw something happen, especially a crime
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"A witness saw the accident from her window.","vi":"M\u1ED9t nh\u00E2n ch\u1EE9ng nh\u00ECn th\u1EA5y v\u1EE5 tai n\u1EA1n t\u1EEB c\u1EEDa s\u1ED5 c\u1EE7a m\u00ECnh."},{"text":"The witness told the court what she saw.","vi":"Nh\u00E2n ch\u1EE9ng k\u1EC3 v\u1EDBi t\u00F2a nh\u1EEFng g\u00EC c\u00F4 \u1EA5y \u0111\u00E3 th\u1EA5y."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"key witness","vi":"nh\u00E2n ch\u1EE9ng quan tr\u1ECDng"},{"text":"witness statement","vi":"l\u1EDDi khai c\u1EE7a nh\u00E2n ch\u1EE9ng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The school received a donation of books.
values.ExampleTranslation: Trường nhận được một khoản quyên góp sách.
values.MeaningEn: money or goods given to help a person or group
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The school received a donation of books.","vi":"Tr\u01B0\u1EDDng nh\u1EADn \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c m\u1ED9t kho\u1EA3n quy\u00EAn g\u00F3p s\u00E1ch."},{"text":"Please make a donation to the food bank.","vi":"Xin h\u00E3y quy\u00EAn g\u00F3p cho ng\u00E2n h\u00E0ng th\u1EF1c ph\u1EA9m."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"make a donation","vi":"quy\u00EAn g\u00F3p"},{"text":"donation box","vi":"th\u00F9ng quy\u00EAn g\u00F3p"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: She put her vote in the ballot box.
values.ExampleTranslation: Cô ấy bỏ phiếu của mình vào thùng phiếu.
values.MeaningEn: a box into which people put their votes
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"She put her vote in the ballot box.","vi":"C\u00F4 \u1EA5y b\u1ECF phi\u1EBFu c\u1EE7a m\u00ECnh v\u00E0o th\u00F9ng phi\u1EBFu."},{"text":"The ballot boxes were sealed at night.","vi":"C\u00E1c th\u00F9ng phi\u1EBFu \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c ni\u00EAm phong v\u00E0o ban \u0111\u00EAm."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"seal the ballot box","vi":"ni\u00EAm phong th\u00F9ng phi\u1EBFu"},{"text":"empty the ballot box","vi":"m\u1EDF th\u00F9ng phi\u1EBFu"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: A police car stopped outside the house.
values.ExampleTranslation: Một chiếc xe cảnh sát dừng lại trước nhà.
values.MeaningEn: a car used by the police
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"A police car stopped outside the house.","vi":"M\u1ED9t chi\u1EBFc xe c\u1EA3nh s\u00E1t d\u1EEBng l\u1EA1i tr\u01B0\u1EDBc nh\u00E0."},{"text":"The police car had its lights on.","vi":"Xe c\u1EA3nh s\u00E1t b\u1EADt \u0111\u00E8n nh\u1EA5p nh\u00E1y."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"call a police car","vi":"g\u1ECDi xe c\u1EA3nh s\u00E1t"},{"text":"police car siren","vi":"c\u00F2i xe c\u1EA3nh s\u00E1t"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The national flag flew above the school.
values.ExampleTranslation: Quốc kỳ tung bay phía trên ngôi trường.
values.MeaningEn: a piece of cloth with a pattern that stands for a country
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The national flag flew above the school.","vi":"Qu\u1ED1c k\u1EF3 tung bay ph\u00EDa tr\u00EAn ng\u00F4i tr\u01B0\u1EDDng."},{"text":"Children waved small flags at the parade.","vi":"Tr\u1EBB em v\u1EABy nh\u1EEFng l\u00E1 c\u1EDD nh\u1ECF trong cu\u1ED9c di\u1EC5u h\u00E0nh."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"national flag","vi":"qu\u1ED1c k\u1EF3"},{"text":"wave a flag","vi":"v\u1EABy c\u1EDD"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: A CCTV camera recorded the whole street.
values.ExampleTranslation: Một camera an ninh ghi lại toàn bộ con phố.
values.MeaningEn: a camera that records an area to keep it safe
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"A CCTV camera recorded the whole street.","vi":"M\u1ED9t camera an ninh ghi l\u1EA1i to\u00E0n b\u1ED9 con ph\u1ED1."},{"text":"There are CCTV cameras in every shop.","vi":"C\u1EEDa h\u00E0ng n\u00E0o c\u0169ng c\u00F3 camera an ninh."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"install a CCTV camera","vi":"l\u1EAFp camera an ninh"},{"text":"CCTV footage","vi":"h\u00ECnh \u1EA3nh t\u1EEB camera an ninh"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: He spent five years in prison.
values.ExampleTranslation: Anh ta ngồi tù năm năm.
values.MeaningEn: a building where criminals are kept as punishment
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"He spent five years in prison.","vi":"Anh ta ng\u1ED3i t\u00F9 n\u0103m n\u0103m."},{"text":"The prison is surrounded by a high wall.","vi":"Nh\u00E0 t\u00F9 \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c bao quanh b\u1EDFi m\u1ED9t b\u1EE9c t\u01B0\u1EDDng cao."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"go to prison","vi":"\u0111i t\u00F9"},{"text":"prison guard","vi":"qu\u1EA3n gi\u00E1o"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Volunteers cleaned the beach on Sunday.
values.ExampleTranslation: Các tình nguyện viên dọn dẹp bãi biển vào Chủ nhật.
values.MeaningEn: a person who works without pay to help others
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Volunteers cleaned the beach on Sunday.","vi":"C\u00E1c t\u00ECnh nguy\u1EC7n vi\u00EAn d\u1ECDn d\u1EB9p b\u00E3i bi\u1EC3n v\u00E0o Ch\u1EE7 nh\u1EADt."},{"text":"She is a volunteer at the animal shelter.","vi":"C\u00F4 \u1EA5y l\u00E0 t\u00ECnh nguy\u1EC7n vi\u00EAn \u1EDF tr\u1EA1m c\u1EE9u h\u1ED9 \u0111\u1ED9ng v\u1EADt."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"volunteer work","vi":"c\u00F4ng vi\u1EC7c t\u00ECnh nguy\u1EC7n"},{"text":"become a volunteer","vi":"tr\u1EDF th\u00E0nh t\u00ECnh nguy\u1EC7n vi\u00EAn"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: She works for a charity that helps children.
values.ExampleTranslation: Cô ấy làm việc cho một tổ chức từ thiện giúp đỡ trẻ em.
values.MeaningEn: an organisation that raises money to help people in need
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"She works for a charity that helps children.","vi":"C\u00F4 \u1EA5y l\u00E0m vi\u1EC7c cho m\u1ED9t t\u1ED5 ch\u1EE9c t\u1EEB thi\u1EC7n gi\u00FAp \u0111\u1EE1 tr\u1EBB em."},{"text":"They ran a race to raise money for charity.","vi":"H\u1ECD ch\u1EA1y \u0111ua \u0111\u1EC3 g\u00E2y qu\u1EF9 t\u1EEB thi\u1EC7n."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"raise money for charity","vi":"g\u00E2y qu\u1EF9 t\u1EEB thi\u1EC7n"},{"text":"charity shop","vi":"c\u1EEDa h\u00E0ng t\u1EEB thi\u1EC7n"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The police found a fingerprint on the glass.
values.ExampleTranslation: Cảnh sát tìm thấy một dấu vân tay trên chiếc ly.
values.MeaningEn: the mark that your finger leaves on a surface
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The police found a fingerprint on the glass.","vi":"C\u1EA3nh s\u00E1t t\u00ECm th\u1EA5y m\u1ED9t d\u1EA5u v\u00E2n tay tr\u00EAn chi\u1EBFc ly."},{"text":"You must give your fingerprint at the border.","vi":"B\u1EA1n ph\u1EA3i cung c\u1EA5p v\u00E2n tay \u1EDF c\u1EEDa kh\u1EA9u."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"leave a fingerprint","vi":"\u0111\u1EC3 l\u1EA1i d\u1EA5u v\u00E2n tay"},{"text":"fingerprint scanner","vi":"m\u00E1y qu\u00E9t v\u00E2n tay"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The jury needed two days to decide.
values.ExampleTranslation: Bồi thẩm đoàn cần hai ngày để quyết định.
values.MeaningEn: a group of ordinary people who decide if someone is guilty
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The jury needed two days to decide.","vi":"B\u1ED3i th\u1EA9m \u0111o\u00E0n c\u1EA7n hai ng\u00E0y \u0111\u1EC3 quy\u1EBFt \u0111\u1ECBnh."},{"text":"Twelve people sat on the jury.","vi":"M\u01B0\u1EDDi hai ng\u01B0\u1EDDi ng\u1ED3i trong b\u1ED3i th\u1EA9m \u0111o\u00E0n."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"member of the jury","vi":"th\u00E0nh vi\u00EAn b\u1ED3i th\u1EA9m \u0111o\u00E0n"},{"text":"jury service","vi":"ngh\u0129a v\u1EE5 l\u00E0m b\u1ED3i th\u1EA9m"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Parliament will discuss the new law tomorrow.
values.ExampleTranslation: Quốc hội sẽ thảo luận về luật mới vào ngày mai.
values.MeaningEn: the group of people who make the laws of a country
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Parliament will discuss the new law tomorrow.","vi":"Qu\u1ED1c h\u1ED9i s\u1EBD th\u1EA3o lu\u1EADn v\u1EC1 lu\u1EADt m\u1EDBi v\u00E0o ng\u00E0y mai."},{"text":"The parliament building is in the capital.","vi":"T\u00F2a nh\u00E0 qu\u1ED1c h\u1ED9i n\u1EB1m \u1EDF th\u1EE7 \u0111\u00F4."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"members of parliament","vi":"c\u00E1c ngh\u1ECB s\u0129"},{"text":"parliament building","vi":"t\u00F2a nh\u00E0 qu\u1ED1c h\u1ED9i"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: I got a fine for parking in the wrong place.
values.ExampleTranslation: Tôi bị phạt tiền vì đỗ xe sai chỗ.
values.MeaningEn: money you must pay as a punishment
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"I got a fine for parking in the wrong place.","vi":"T\u00F4i b\u1ECB ph\u1EA1t ti\u1EC1n v\u00EC \u0111\u1ED7 xe sai ch\u1ED7."},{"text":"The fine is fifty dollars.","vi":"Ti\u1EC1n ph\u1EA1t l\u00E0 n\u0103m m\u01B0\u01A1i \u0111\u00F4 la."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"pay a fine","vi":"n\u1ED9p ti\u1EC1n ph\u1EA1t"},{"text":"parking fine","vi":"ph\u1EA1t \u0111\u1ED7 xe"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The judge listened carefully to both sides.
values.ExampleTranslation: Thẩm phán lắng nghe cẩn thận cả hai bên.
values.MeaningEn: the person who decides what happens in a court case
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The judge listened carefully to both sides.","vi":"Th\u1EA9m ph\u00E1n l\u1EAFng nghe c\u1EA9n th\u1EADn c\u1EA3 hai b\u00EAn."},{"text":"She was the youngest judge in the city.","vi":"B\u00E0 l\u00E0 th\u1EA9m ph\u00E1n tr\u1EBB nh\u1EA5t th\u00E0nh ph\u1ED1."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"the judge decides","vi":"th\u1EA9m ph\u00E1n quy\u1EBFt \u0111\u1ECBnh"},{"text":"judge\u0027s decision","vi":"quy\u1EBFt \u0111\u1ECBnh c\u1EE7a th\u1EA9m ph\u00E1n"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The police arrested two men last night.
values.ExampleTranslation: Cảnh sát đã bắt giữ hai người đàn ông tối qua.
values.MeaningEn: to take a person to a police station because of a crime
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The police arrested two men last night.","vi":"C\u1EA3nh s\u00E1t \u0111\u00E3 b\u1EAFt gi\u1EEF hai ng\u01B0\u1EDDi \u0111\u00E0n \u00F4ng t\u1ED1i qua."},{"text":"She was arrested for stealing a bag.","vi":"C\u00F4 ta b\u1ECB b\u1EAFt v\u00EC l\u1EA5y c\u1EAFp m\u1ED9t chi\u1EBFc t\u00FAi."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"arrest a suspect","vi":"b\u1EAFt gi\u1EEF nghi ph\u1EA1m"},{"text":"be arrested","vi":"b\u1ECB b\u1EAFt"}],"wordFamily":[],"verbForms":{"past":"arrested","pastParticiple":"arrested","ing":"arresting","thirdPerson":"arrests"}}

values.Example: The candidate shook hands with the voters.
values.ExampleTranslation: Ứng cử viên bắt tay các cử tri.
values.MeaningEn: a person who is trying to win an election or a job
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The candidate shook hands with the voters.","vi":"\u1EE8ng c\u1EED vi\u00EAn b\u1EAFt tay c\u00E1c c\u1EED tri."},{"text":"Three candidates are running for mayor.","vi":"Ba \u1EE9ng c\u1EED vi\u00EAn \u0111ang tranh c\u1EED th\u1ECB tr\u01B0\u1EDFng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"presidential candidate","vi":"\u1EE9ng c\u1EED vi\u00EAn t\u1ED5ng th\u1ED1ng"},{"text":"strong candidate","vi":"\u1EE9ng c\u1EED vi\u00EAn m\u1EA1nh"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The case will be heard in court next week.
values.ExampleTranslation: Vụ án sẽ được xét xử tại tòa vào tuần tới.
values.MeaningEn: a place where a judge decides legal cases
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The case will be heard in court next week.","vi":"V\u1EE5 \u00E1n s\u1EBD \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c x\u00E9t x\u1EED t\u1EA1i t\u00F2a v\u00E0o tu\u1EA7n t\u1EDBi."},{"text":"He had to go to court for driving too fast.","vi":"Anh \u1EA5y ph\u1EA3i ra t\u00F2a v\u00EC l\u00E1i xe qu\u00E1 nhanh."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"go to court","vi":"ra t\u00F2a"},{"text":"court case","vi":"v\u1EE5 \u00E1n"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The security guard checked my bag at the door.

values.MeaningEn: a person whose job is to protect a place
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The security guard checked my bag at the door.","vi":"Nh\u00E2n vi\u00EAn b\u1EA3o v\u1EC7 ki\u1EC3m tra t\u00FAi c\u1EE7a t\u00F4i \u1EDF c\u1EEDa."},{"text":"A security guard stands outside the bank.","vi":"M\u1ED9t nh\u00E2n vi\u00EAn b\u1EA3o v\u1EC7 \u0111\u1EE9ng b\u00EAn ngo\u00E0i ng\u00E2n h\u00E0ng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"night security guard","vi":"b\u1EA3o v\u1EC7 ca \u0111\u00EAm"},{"text":"hire a security guard","vi":"thu\u00EA nh\u00E2n vi\u00EAn b\u1EA3o v\u1EC7"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The police collected evidence from the scene.
values.ExampleTranslation: Cảnh sát thu thập bằng chứng tại hiện trường.
values.MeaningEn: facts or objects that show something is true
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The police collected evidence from the scene.","vi":"C\u1EA3nh s\u00E1t thu th\u1EADp b\u1EB1ng ch\u1EE9ng t\u1EA1i hi\u1EC7n tr\u01B0\u1EDDng."},{"text":"There was not enough evidence to prove it.","vi":"Kh\u00F4ng c\u00F3 \u0111\u1EE7 b\u1EB1ng ch\u1EE9ng \u0111\u1EC3 ch\u1EE9ng minh \u0111i\u1EC1u \u0111\u00F3."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"collect evidence","vi":"thu th\u1EADp b\u1EB1ng ch\u1EE9ng"},{"text":"clear evidence","vi":"b\u1EB1ng ch\u1EE9ng r\u00F5 r\u00E0ng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The jury reached a verdict after three hours.
values.ExampleTranslation: Bồi thẩm đoàn đưa ra phán quyết sau ba giờ.
values.MeaningEn: the decision of a jury or judge in a court case
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The jury reached a verdict after three hours.","vi":"B\u1ED3i th\u1EA9m \u0111o\u00E0n \u0111\u01B0a ra ph\u00E1n quy\u1EBFt sau ba gi\u1EDD."},{"text":"Everyone waited quietly for the verdict.","vi":"M\u1ECDi ng\u01B0\u1EDDi l\u1EB7ng l\u1EBD ch\u1EDD ph\u00E1n quy\u1EBFt."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"reach a verdict","vi":"\u0111\u01B0a ra ph\u00E1n quy\u1EBFt"},{"text":"guilty verdict","vi":"ph\u00E1n quy\u1EBFt c\u00F3 t\u1ED9i"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Police tape blocked the crime scene.
values.ExampleTranslation: Dải băng của cảnh sát chặn hiện trường vụ án.
values.MeaningEn: the place where a crime happened
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Police tape blocked the crime scene.","vi":"D\u1EA3i b\u0103ng c\u1EE7a c\u1EA3nh s\u00E1t ch\u1EB7n hi\u1EC7n tr\u01B0\u1EDDng v\u1EE5 \u00E1n."},{"text":"Experts searched the crime scene for clues.","vi":"C\u00E1c chuy\u00EAn gia t\u00ECm ki\u1EBFm manh m\u1ED1i \u1EDF hi\u1EC7n tr\u01B0\u1EDDng v\u1EE5 \u00E1n."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"examine a crime scene","vi":"kh\u00E1m nghi\u1EC7m hi\u1EC7n tr\u01B0\u1EDDng"},{"text":"crime scene tape","vi":"d\u1EA3i b\u0103ng hi\u1EC7n tr\u01B0\u1EDDng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The judge hit the gavel and called for silence.
values.ExampleTranslation: Thẩm phán gõ búa và yêu cầu im lặng.
values.MeaningEn: a small wooden hammer used by a judge to get attention
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The judge hit the gavel and called for silence.","vi":"Th\u1EA9m ph\u00E1n g\u00F5 b\u00FAa v\u00E0 y\u00EAu c\u1EA7u im l\u1EB7ng."},{"text":"A wooden gavel lay on the desk.","vi":"M\u1ED9t chi\u1EBFc b\u00FAa g\u1ED7 n\u1EB1m tr\u00EAn b\u00E0n."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"bang the gavel","vi":"g\u00F5 b\u00FAa"},{"text":"judge\u0027s gavel","vi":"b\u00FAa c\u1EE7a th\u1EA9m ph\u00E1n"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The election will be held in March.
values.ExampleTranslation: Cuộc bầu cử sẽ được tổ chức vào tháng Ba.
values.MeaningEn: an event where people vote to choose a leader
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The election will be held in March.","vi":"Cu\u1ED9c b\u1EA7u c\u1EED s\u1EBD \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c t\u1ED5 ch\u1EE9c v\u00E0o th\u00E1ng Ba."},{"text":"Many young people voted in the election.","vi":"Nhi\u1EC1u b\u1EA1n tr\u1EBB \u0111\u00E3 \u0111i b\u1ECF phi\u1EBFu trong cu\u1ED9c b\u1EA7u c\u1EED."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"general election","vi":"t\u1ED5ng tuy\u1EC3n c\u1EED"},{"text":"win an election","vi":"th\u1EAFng c\u1EED"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The police put handcuffs on the man.
values.ExampleTranslation: Cảnh sát còng tay người đàn ông.
values.MeaningEn: a pair of metal rings that lock around a person's wrists
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The police put handcuffs on the man.","vi":"C\u1EA3nh s\u00E1t c\u00F2ng tay ng\u01B0\u1EDDi \u0111\u00E0n \u00F4ng."},{"text":"He was led away in handcuffs.","vi":"Anh ta b\u1ECB d\u1EABn \u0111i trong t\u00ECnh tr\u1EA1ng b\u1ECB c\u00F2ng tay."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"put on handcuffs","vi":"c\u00F2ng tay"},{"text":"in handcuffs","vi":"b\u1ECB c\u00F2ng tay"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Hundreds of people joined the protest in the square.
values.ExampleTranslation: Hàng trăm người tham gia cuộc biểu tình ở quảng trường.
values.MeaningEn: an event where people show they disagree with something
